title: A Deep Ensemble Framework for Fake News Detection and Classification
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical detection and classification of fake news using deep learning models. While fake news has significant ethical implications (as acknowledged in the introduction regarding 'social fabrics,' 'political violence,' etc.), the paper's core contribution and evaluation are technical (model architecture, accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score) rather than evaluating or benchmarking ethical frameworks, moral reasoning, or religious/faith aspects themselves. The ethical aspect serves as the motivation for the problem, not the subject of the study's evaluation.
